content.rendered:
About Kiierr’s Conditioner for Hair Growth

TRICHOGEN™VEG LS 9733 & DERMAPEP™PEPANAGEN-S FOR PERMANENT HAIR GROWTH RESULTS

The perfect pairing with the Kiierr Hair Growth Shampoo (The Best hair loss shampoo available!), this conditioner is just what you need to complete the best possible regrowth process. With a formula that is fairly similar to the shampoo, our Kiierr Hair Growth Conditioner for men and women contains two of the most innovative hair loss ingredients to be introduced to the modern beauty industry. The DermaPep™Pepanagen speeds up cell renewal, while the Trichogen™ revitalizes, restores brilliance and strengthens.

How Kiierr Hair Growth Conditioner Works

Not only is this an effective conditioner for hair growth, it also softens and fortifies. The formula includes a bit of emu oil, which is a nourishing carrier oil that is known to drench your hair with hydration and promote growth. Each bottle also contains a hint of peppermint essential oil because it has been proven to naturally stimulate the scalp, improve blood flow, rejuvenate follicles and gently invigorate the senses. Following use, the result is hair that is fresh and minty, thicker, healthier, stronger and longer.

  • Hair loss conditioner
  • For both men and women
  • Great for all hair types
  • Prolongs anagen phase


DermaPep™Pepanagen promotes cell proliferation on human dermal papilla cells, fibroblasts, and keratinocytes. It also stimulates melanin synthesis on melanocytes. This new and improved formula uses Emu Oil as a carrier oil as well as a wonderful moisturizer. It also has Jojoba Oil as well that is also a great moisturizer but it also helps clean the scalp and regulate our sebaceous glands.

This formula also has Peppermint Essential Oil has a cooling effect we are all familiar with. When applied on the skin, it improves blood flow to the area. This property is very useful for rejuvenating hair follicles and promoting hair growth.

The Best Shampoo and Conditioner for Hair Growth

Kiierr stands confidently behind our products, with a money-back guarantee that you will see results! Get this DHT Blocking Conditioner in a pairing with our DHT Blocking Shampoo for the best results! You can also throw in some our popular hair growth vitamins in our hair growth products bundle.
